Write code that normalizes extracted expense fields into a standard JSON schema using a concrete provider.

REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Azure DI prebuilt invoice:
  Service: Azure Document Intelligence prebuilt invoice
  SDK: azure-ai-documentintelligence
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: begin_analyze_document
  Setup hints: AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT, AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/document-intelligence/prebuilt/invoice

  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: parse, invoice
  Setup hints: MINDEE_API_KEY

  SDK: google-cloud-documentai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: process_document
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/document-ai/docs/processors-list#processor_invoice-parser

  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/textract/latest/dg/API_AnalyzeExpense.html

  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET

output_text:
```python
import os
from typing import Dict, Any, List, Optional
from mindee import Client, product

def normalize_expenses(document_bytes: bytes) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    api_key = os.getenv("MINDEE_API_KEY")
    if not api_key:
        raise ValueError("MINDEE_API_KEY environment variable is required")
    
    mindee_client = Client(api_key=api_key).load(product.InvoiceV4)
    result = mindee_client.parse(document_bytes)
    prediction = result.document.inference.prediction
    
    line_items: List[Dict[str, Optional[float]]] = []
    if prediction.line_items:
        for item in prediction.line_items:
            line_items.append({
                "description": getattr(item.description, "value", None),
                "quantity": float(getattr(item.quantity, "value", 0)) if getattr(item.quantity, "value", None) else None,
                "unit_price": float(getattr(item.unit_price, "value", 0)) if getattr(item.unit_price, "value", None) else None,
                "total_price": float(getattr(item.total_amount, "value", 0)) if getattr(item.total_amount, "value", None) else None,
            })
    
    normalized = {
        "vendor_name": getattr(prediction.supplier.name, "value", None) if prediction.supplier and prediction.supplier.name else None,
        "customer_name": getattr(prediction.customer_name, "value", None),
        "invoice_number": getattr(prediction.invoice_number, "value", None),
        "invoice_date": getattr(prediction.date, "value", None),
        "due_date": getattr(prediction.due_date, "value", None),
        "subtotal": float(getattr(prediction.total_net, "value", 0)) if getattr(prediction.total_net, "value", None) else None,
        "tax_amount": float(getattr(prediction.total_tax, "value", 0)) if getattr(prediction.total_tax, "value", None) else None,
        "total_amount": float(getattr(prediction.total_amount, "value", 0)) if getattr(prediction.total_amount, "value", None) else None,
        "currency": getattr(prediction.total_amount, "confidence", None),  # currency inferred from context, confidence as proxy
        "line_items": line_items
    }
    return normalized
```
